tool.name: longstitch
tool.description: "A genome assembly correction and scaffolding pipeline using long reads, consisting of up to three steps: - Tigmint cuts the draft assembly at potentially misassembled regions - ntLink is then used to scaffold the corrected assembly - followed by ARKS for further scaffolding (optional)"

param.name: threads
param.label: Number of Threads
param.help: Number of CPU threads to use
